compiler_attribution: OpenAssembler torch frontend worker uses AOTAutograd + TorchInductor/Triton; native OpenAssembler PTX/SASS is not used for whole-model graphs; full CLI bundle/replay is not measured
ratio_definition: eager time / compiled time; greater than one means compiled frontend worker is faster
aggregation: median and range of within-round medians; paired ratios computed within each round; failed numerical rounds remain diagnostic only

category_descriptions.gemm: GEMM/GEMV and split-K reduction kernel names; not individual HMMA instruction time
category_descriptions.fused_attention: Fused attention kernels; softmax and attention matmuls remain inseparable
category_descriptions.gelu_activation: GELU forward/backward kernels, including fused forms
category_descriptions.norm_residual_embedding_fused: Triton names mentioning norm/rsqrt/embedding; fused contents are not split
category_descriptions.optimizer_or_grad_clip_multi_tensor: Multi-tensor kernels used by AdamW or gradient clipping
category_descriptions.copy_layout_kernel: CUDA kernels implementing copies, cat, or layout changes; distinct from DMA events
category_descriptions.generic_triton_mixed: Other Triton fused/reduction kernels; semantic assignment intentionally unresolved
category_descriptions.other_recognized_kernel: Recognized real-kernel name family without a narrower assignment

scope_limits: Whole-model compiled path is TorchInductor/Triton managed by the OA frontend, not native OA SASS.
CUDA-event resident-data step timing excludes initialization, compile, zero_grad at step start, and final readback; may include host enqueue gaps.
Program and worker wall time include compilation, profiling, and snapshots and are not isolated compile-time measurements.
Final training state and clipped gradients are checked after one additional post-timing diagnostic optimizer step.
Inference decode recomputes a fixed window, batch one, without a KV cache.
Profiler categories are based on kernel names; fused normalization/activation/residual boundaries are not independently measurable here.
CUDA event durations may overlap across streams; kernel-time sums are diagnostic work totals, not end-to-end latency.
Peak memory includes the separate profiler pass.
Historical annotation correction is derived from explicit name families because original raw data did not retain is_user_annotation.

verification.scope: observed model outputs, final parameters, gradients and optimizer state
